title: ilex kanehirae
intro: Ilex kanehirae, commonly known as Taiwan yew, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliolaceae. The health benefits of Taiwan yew include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antibacterial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Taiwan yew include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
